detail.longDescription: I have a Zod 4 codec to be used with react-hook-form. If I receive null from the backend, I need to encode it to an empty string to make react happy, but decode '' to null when sending that field's value to the backend. So I wrote this codec: export function emptyStringCodec() { return z.codec( z.string(), // input z.string().nullable(), // output to backend { encode: (val) => val ?? '', // into form decode: (val) => (val === '' ? null : val), // to backend } ); } Now, on top of that codec, I want to express that the string is a required field when decoding the output for the backend (or apply any other string checks like .regex etc.). However, when I try to add an additional .min check to the output of the codec: const myFormZod = z.object( { myRequiredField: emptyStringCodec().out.min(1, { error: 'Please enter a value for my required field.', }), } ); The compiler outputs the following: Property min does not exist on type ZodNullable How can I add additional checks to the value I receive from the form?
